cases.title: a send of one more than the balance is refused
a send of exactly the balance gets a temporary vote
an account may spend what an earlier block of the request sends it
the same blocks in the other order are refused: the spend comes before its funding
two blocks of one account that together spend more than its balance are refused
a receive of more than was sent to the account in the request is refused
an exact receive of exactly what was sent gets a temporary vote
a receive counts only what was sent before it in the request
a send of nothing gets a temporary vote
a negative amount, in a block dated before the cutoff that still admits one, is refused by the ledger's operation check
burning more than the token holds unallocated is refused, though the supply covers it; burning exactly that is given
a mint that takes the supply past its maximum is refused
a token created with the maximum supply gets a temporary vote
an overspend and a mint past the maximum supply are refused for the supply, which is checked before any balance
